evidence: Vertical Pfirsch–Schlüter current density is the height-axis projection of the [Pfirsch–Schlüter current-density vector](name:pfirsch_schlueter_current_density)

evidence: It combines their thermal stresses rather than selecting one ion species, one charge state, or one directional pressure component.
